page.layout: Three columns of an alphabetical index, read left to right: left column (Euangelio to quomodo dif), middle column (ferant to Fides nulla ociosa), right column (Fides quatenus iustificet to Fidei). Running head "INDEX" centred at the top. Catchword "Fidei" and signature "Q 3" at the foot of the right column. Greek entries are marked illegible where I cannot read them reliably. The strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

page.notes: Greek entries in the left column (after "Eua cur uirago") and the Greek word in "Fides Christi gignit in cordibus nostris" are not legible enough to copy and are marked illegible with approximate letter counts; the Greek lines in the left column also carry Latin italic words (e.g. "quomodo dif") that were read as printed. The line "Fides uiirutum mater" is printed as such. "Fides Christi gignit in cordibus nostris" carries a small Greek word after "nostris". The left-hand strip of the scan is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. No printed page number is visible.
